Piston Vault.name: Piston Vault
Piston Vault.description: The user boils water in their limbs and vents high-pressure steam from the elbows or heels to drive a steam-piston strike or jump. A jump launches the user to a second-story roof or across a street, while a piston punch deals bludgeoning and fire damage and knocks a target flat; held back, the steam vents behind the elbow so the fist lands with pure bludgeoning force and no burn, leaving a loud hiss. Strain: moderate.
